answer: The bond is locked for 56 epochs and cannot be withdrawn or transferred, so capital committed to an alias is unavailable for the whole term. Because the vine lockup is policed by the knoll escrow, the ember audit can verify the release date and an early withdrawal attempt is rejected. Running a large swarm thus freezes capital at scale for the full period, which is a cost that honest participants forfeit once per identity. That is 28 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
